verdict.rationale: LocalAI is documented as a single binary or Docker container that serves an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API, driven by CLI flags and environment variables such as PRELOAD_MODELS. That clearly supports headless server deployment. However, the docs never explicitly describe a no-GUI or headless mode (the built-in web interface ships by default), and they don't document use inside CI pipelines. The 'tested in CI' quote refers to LocalAI's own testing, not user pipelines. Missing for 10: an explicit headless/no-UI mode or flag to disable the web interface, documented CI-pipeline usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it. Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
